en.title: Sorting Bug Reports by Frequency and ID
en.description:
Sort all bug IDs in ascending order of frequency; ties in frequency are broken by ID in ascending order, and duplicates are kept.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O, examples, and judging.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..200000), and the second line contains n IDs (1..1000000).
en.explanation: Example 1: 1, 3, 4 each appear once and are output first by ID; 2 appears twice and goes last. Example 2: equal frequencies, output 1 2. Example 3: both frequencies are 2, output 1 1 2 2.
hints: First count the frequencies, then sort the original array by (frequency, ID).
